overview: Salaberry-de-Valleyfield had 42,787 residents in the 2021 Census, up 5.0 percent from 40,745 in 2016, faster than the Quebec average. Its 20,073 occupied dwellings spread across 108.56 square kilometres, including the former towns of Saint-Timothée and Grande-Île.

Heavy industry, a port and new logistics warehouses provide a broad job base, led by a major zinc refinery and a Diageo plant. Local businesses compete for working households and for contracts from industrial employers, often against service providers based in the Montreal area.
